This '''unidentified [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]''' fought and died in the [[Battle of Anoth (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of]] [[Anoth/Legends|Anoth]].

==Biography==
This man graduated from the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]]. As a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]], he rose to the rank of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]. During the [[Destruction of Carida]], he managed to survive, as he and fourteen other [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] were chosen to pilot the [[Mountain Terrain Armored Transport|MT-ATs]] for the [[Battle of Anoth (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Anoth]]. Loaded onboard the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser]] [[Vendetta (Dreadnaught-class)|Vendetta]], he escaped the deaths of many of his comrades. Although he intended to go alone, he reluctantly chaperoned [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Furgan]], secretly suffering his screams of panic. After losing three [[Mountain Terrain Armored Transport|MT-ATs]] and seven [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]], they came across [[Winter Celchu|Winter]]. While six of his comrades pursued the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] woman, the [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] and [[Furgan]] located what they wanted; [[Anakin Solo]]. With only an [[XL-Lioness]] [[TDL nanny droid]], [[Furgan]] expected nothing, but this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was equipped with blasters. There, the [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] died at her hands.
